title: What is RAG? AI Explained Simply
description: Why do chatbots make things up, and how does RAG fix it? Thoma explains retrieval augmented generation with an open-book exam.

scenes.say: Why does a chatbot confidently make things up?
Because it answers from memory, like a student in a closed-book exam. If it never learned the answer, it guesses.
RAG gives it an open book. First, your question goes to a search step. It finds the right documents. Then the model writes the answer using them.
So the answer is based on real text, not a guess.
Here's the code version: search first, then ask.
So remember: RAG means look it up first, then answer. See you at the board.

visual.text: RAG = *look it up first*, then answer.
